description: This file defines data models related to scheduled cron jobs, including their configurations, statuses, and associated enums for session targeting, wake modes, delivery modes, payloads, and scheduling options. It serves as the core data structure definitions for managing and representing cron job information within the application.

classes.name: CronJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled cron job with its configuration, status, and associated metadata.

classes.name: CronSchedule
classes.description: Enumeration representing different scheduling options such as exact time, recurring interval, or cron expression.

classes.name: CronPayload
classes.description: Payloads for cron jobs, encompassing system events and agent interactions.

classes.name: CronDelivery
classes.description: Defines delivery parameters for job notifications, including mode and channels.

classes.name: CronJobState
classes.description: Tracks the runtime state of a cron job such as last run time, status, and error information.

classes.name: CronEvent
classes.description: Represents an execution event of a cron job, including status and timing details.

classes.name: CronRunLogEntry
classes.description: Log entry recording details of individual cron job executions.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CronCustomSessionTarget from a string value, distinguishing between predefined targets and custom session IDs.

methods.name: parseAtDate
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a date into a Date object, supporting ISO8601 formats.

methods.name: formatIsoDate
methods.description: Converts a Date object into an ISO8601 string without fractional seconds.

methods.name: makeIsoFormatter
methods.description: Creates a configured ISO8601DateFormatter with options for fractional seconds.
